comment: Expected-failure assertions for run_header_gate.mjs. Every shipped header must compile standalone for every target, except the entries below, which must instead fail with the stated diagnostic signature. An entry is a positive assertion about designed behavior, not a skip: if the compile succeeds, or fails with a different diagnostic, the gate fails.

expectations.reason: Intentional error stub: TCC no longer implements <varargs.h>, and the header's whole content is the #error directing users to <stdarg.h>.

The compiler's predefinition header: the compiler applies its contents to every translation unit itself, so an explicit #include redefines them (struct __uint128__). It ships as part of the set, not as an includable header.

Sub-header of the libcurl umbrella: curl.h includes it last, after its own preamble defines size_t and the curl types. It is only meaningful through <curl/curl.h>, which compiles standalone and pulls it in.
Sub-header of the libcurl umbrella: curl.h includes it last, after defining CURLoption and the curl types. It is only meaningful through <curl/curl.h>, which compiles standalone and pulls it in.
Sub-header of the libcurl umbrella: curl.h includes it last, after its own preamble defines size_t. It is only meaningful through <curl/curl.h>, which compiles standalone and pulls it in.
Sub-header of the libcurl umbrella: curl.h includes it last, after defining curl_off_t. It is only meaningful through <curl/curl.h>, which compiles standalone and pulls it in.

GCC-only typecheck implementation detail of libcurl: its warning functions are written with __asm__, which the wasm backend does not support. curl.h includes it only under a GCC version guard TCC does not satisfy, so it is inert through the umbrella, which compiles standalone.

Internal Mbed TLS header: it #errors on direct inclusion by upstream design and is included automatically by build_info.h at the right point. It ships because build_info.h needs it in the sysroot, not as an includable header.
